candidates.structural_interaction: Depth meeting depth cross-polarity — intelligence competing with intelligence
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Rival: current that races current. You compete the way tides do, quietly, continuously, gaining by inches that look like accidents. Shared flows suit you: pooled funds, joint journeys, split winnings. Just remember that merged water is hard to unmix. Mark what is yours before the confluence.

k2_functional.mind: You think in currents of advantage: where things flow, who is upstream, what leaks.
k2_functional.expression: You compete so smoothly it reads as cooperation until the finish.
k2_functional.order: You probe order like water probes a dam: respectfully, constantly, and straight through the first crack.
k2_functional.action: You advance through openings others miss, water finding the crack in every dam.
k2_functional.body: Your energy ebbs and floods: read your own tide chart and schedule accordingly.

k2_domain_readings.Rivalry: Your rivalries run underwater: unspoken races, silent measurements, positions gained without visible waves. Surface one or two. A named, laughing rivalry refreshes you more than ten secret ones.
k2_domain_readings.Shared stakes: Money and effort pool around you like watersheds: group funds, family flows, blended accounts. You track it all mentally and forgive it all eventually. Put banks around what must not flood away.
k2_domain_readings.Boldness: Your daring is fluid: risks taken by drift and momentum more than announcement. It carries you far. Just check occasionally that the current you are riding is one you chose.
